description: PMSV4 – Se tillstånd på belagda vägar is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by pmsv4.trafikverket.se. A display system to see where and what occupancy and dewatering measures have been reported for paved and gravel roads and to look at the measured and calculated condition of the paved roads. Relevant road data is also obtained from the NVDB for both paved and gravel roads. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "PMSV4 - See condition of paved roads" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include karttjänst, map service. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-04-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
